{{Quote|Also, fine-mesh the hemisphere sensor screen. I don't want any more explosives getting through without at least knowing they're coming.|Colonel Mosh Barris|<ref name="Mist Encounter">{{JournalCite|7|Mist Encounter}}</ref>}}
A '''hemisphere sensor screen''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. One was deployed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Mosh Barris/Legends|Barris]] during an operation to capture [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Thrawn's exile)/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The screen's mesh could be fine tuned to detect small threats, but when used in an area with a large number of small life forms like animals and [[Bird/Legends|birds]], the constant movement could trigger alarms if the screen was fine-meshed too far.
